This shard compiles Section 6.01(b) clauses (12), (18), (19), (27), (31), (32), (33), the satisfy-and-discharge refinancing paragraph, and the closing 'for purposes of determining compliance' / FX / subordination-interpretation rules. Clauses (13), (14) sub-parts, (20), (21), (28)-(30) are explicitly owned by other shards per the SOURCE OMITTED markers and were not compiled or claimed here.

Each of clauses (12)(b), (18)(i), (19) and (27) states its own self-contained 'greater of $X and Y% of Consolidated EBITDA' cap; the cross-references to Section 6.01(b)(13) describe usage of that shared aggregate ceiling by related Refinancing Indebtedness rather than a second independently-restated ceiling. Because Section 6.01(b)(13) itself is owned by other shards and not part of this submission, each relationship is preserved as a SHARES_CAPACITY_WITH dependsOn edge with an exact section-reference target rather than a WireSharedCapacity with an out-of-scope member.

Several cross-references to 'Section 6.01(b)(1)' (including sub-parts (X)/(Y)) were independently flagged by upstream resolution as AMBIGUOUS because two substantive occurrences share that citation in the document; these are preserved as dependsOn edges and reflected in the affected rules' sufficiency (AMBIGUOUS for r11, PARTIAL for r15) rather than silently resolved.

Defined terms such as 'Available RP Capacity Amount', 'Available Amount', 'Incremental Equivalent Debt' and 'Consolidated EBITDA' are represented via DEFINED_TERM_REFERENCE/METRIC_REFERENCE consistent with the compiler's convention of not inlining another provision's/term's own multi-level formula (the same treatment given to 'Consolidated EBITDA' in the worked examples).
